scenarios.name: JOHNSON/MIKE MR
speech: Good afternoon.
I'm travelling with my surfboard today.
Will there be an additional charge for oversized baggage?

scenarios.name: GARCIA/MARIA MS
speech: I'd like to keep my backpack with me during the flight.
Will it fit in the overhead compartment?

scenarios.name: SMITH/DAVID MR
speech: I seem to have misplaced my baggage receipt.
Will I still be able to collect my suitcase?

scenarios.name: WILSON/MARGARET MRS
speech: I only have 30 minutes to catch my next flight.
Is it possible for my suitcase to be unloaded first?

scenarios.name: ANDERSON/EMMA MS
speech: I'm travelling with ski equipment.
I've been told oversized baggage is usually delivered last.

scenarios.name: BROWN/THOMAS MR
speech: This package contains a very delicate antique vase.
Could you please mark it as fragile?

scenarios.name: LEE/DAVID MR
speech: My suitcase hasn't arrived.
Everyone else has already collected their baggage.

scenarios.name: MARTINEZ/ISABEL MS
speech: I arrived this morning from New York.
I've been informed my baggage will arrive on a later flight.

scenarios.name: CLARK/JAMES MR
speech: I have three large suitcases.
Will I need to pay for excess baggage?

scenarios.name: HARRIS/ROBERT MR
speech: Thank you for your assistance.
I can confirm that my booking has been successfully processed.

scenarios.name: DAVIS/EMILY MS
speech: I submitted a request for an aisle seat yesterday.
Has my request been approved yet?

scenarios.name: MILLER/CHRIS MR
speech: I'd like to travel on the next available flight to London.
Could you tell me if any seats are still available?

scenarios.name: THOMPSON/LAURA MS
speech: My flight is fully booked.
I've been informed that there are no remaining seats.

scenarios.name: WALKER/PETER MR
speech: I purchased my ticket several months ago.
I haven't decided on my travel date yet.

scenarios.name: WHITE/SOPHIA MS
speech: I'm flying to Tokyo via Amsterdam today.
Could you confirm my corresponding flight details?

scenarios.name: MOORE/DANIEL MR
speech: My inbound flight arrived two hours late.
I believe I've missed my onward connection.

scenarios.name: TAYLOR/ANNA MS
speech: I only have 45 minutes between my flights.
Is that enough time to make my connection?

scenarios.name: JACKSON/MARK MR
speech: My next flight departs in 15 minutes.
Could someone help me reach the gate as quickly as possible?

scenarios.name: PATEL/ANITA MS
speech: I don't eat meat or dairy products.
I requested an Asian vegetarian meal when I booked my ticket.

scenarios.name: JOHNSON/BABY EMMA
speech: We're travelling with our eight-month-old daughter.
Could you confirm that her baby meal has been loaded?

scenarios.name: SMITH/OLIVER MSTR
speech: My son is a very picky eater.
We ordered a children's meal for him.

scenarios.name: BROWN/THOMAS MR
speech: I have diabetes and need to manage my blood sugar carefully.
I requested a diabetic meal for this flight.

scenarios.name: WILSON/EMMA MS
speech: I have celiac disease.
I requested a gluten-free meal when I booked my ticket.

scenarios.name: KUMAR/RAJ MR
speech: I follow a Hindu diet.
Could you verify that my meal request has been confirmed?

scenarios.name: DAVIS/SARAH MS
speech: I'm currently following a low-fat diet.
I ordered a suitable meal in advance.

scenarios.name: MILLER/JAMES MR
speech: My doctor advised me to reduce my salt intake.
I requested a low sodium meal.

scenarios.name: COHEN/DAVID MR
speech: I observe kosher dietary requirements.
Can you confirm my kosher meal is available?

scenarios.name: AHMED/FATIMA MS
speech: I only eat halal food.
I requested a Muslim meal for today's flight.

scenarios.name: CLARK/JULIA MS
speech: I'm lactose intolerant.
I would like to confirm my non-lactose meal request.

scenarios.name: GREEN/ADAM MR
speech: I only eat uncooked fruits and vegetables.
I ordered a raw vegetarian meal.

scenarios.name: LEE/GRACE MS
speech: I love seafood and requested a special meal.
Could you check whether my seafood meal is on board?

scenarios.name: JONES/PETER MR
speech: I have specific dietary requirements that are not listed online.
I arranged a special meal with the airline.

scenarios.name: WHITE/LISA MS
speech: I follow a strict vegan lifestyle.
I requested a vegetarian meal without any animal products.

scenarios.name: TAYLOR/MICHAEL MR
speech: I don't eat meat, but I do consume dairy products.
I requested a western vegetarian meal.

scenarios.name: MARTINEZ/CARLOS MR
speech: I am travelling to the United States today.
Do I need to provide my passenger information before departure?

scenarios.name: SMITH/LUCAS MSTR
speech: My son is 9 years old.
Does he qualify for a child fare?

scenarios.name: JOHNSON/EMILY MS
speech: I travel with your airline every week for business.
I was informed that I have Commercial Important Passenger status.

scenarios.name: BROWN/PETER MR
speech: My mobile number has changed since I made my reservation.
Could you please update my contact details?

scenarios.name: DAVIS/BABY ANNA
speech: My daughter will be travelling on my lap during the flight.
Does she need her own boarding pass?

scenarios.name: DE VRIES/JAN MR
speech: I am travelling on official duty for the Royal Military Police.
My identification documents are available upon request.

scenarios.name: WILSON/ROBERT MR
speech: Good afternoon.
I am a passenger on flight KL686 to Rome.

scenarios.name: LEE/GRACE MS
speech: How many passengers are travelling on today's flight?
The departure lounge seems very busy.

scenarios.name: CLARK/THOMAS MR
speech: I am travelling to South Africa next week.
Where can I find the latest travel requirements?

scenarios.name: ANDERSON/SOPHIA MS
speech: I have been escorted to the lounge by airport staff.
I understand I have been registered as a Very Important Person.

scenarios.name: JONES/ETHAN MR
speech: I'm 15 years old and travelling alone today.
Are there any additional procedures I should know about?

scenarios.name: MILLER/JAMES MR
speech: My ticket says the flight departs at 18:00.
Has daylight saving time already started in Spain?

scenarios.name: WHITE/LISA MS
speech: The operations report lists all times in UTC.
Could you explain what UTC means?

scenarios.name: HARRIS/MARK CAPT
speech: Air Traffic Control provided the weather briefing in Zulu time.
Please convert it to local time for the crew.

scenarios.name: TAYLOR/OLIVIA MS
speech: I need to make changes to my reservation.
Could you please retrieve my Passenger Name Record?

scenarios.name: JOHNSON/SARAH MS
speech: My dog is travelling in the hold today.
Could you confirm that he has been checked in properly?

scenarios.name: SMITH/ALAN MR
speech: I am visually impaired.
Could someone assist me to the departure gate?

scenarios.name: WILSON/EMMA MRS
speech: We are travelling with our six-month-old daughter.
Is it possible to reserve a bassinet?

scenarios.name: LEE/JASON MR
speech: I am hearing impaired.
Could you please provide important announcements in writing?

scenarios.name: MARTINEZ/CARLOS MR
speech: I have been removed from another country.
Airport authorities instructed me to report to your desk.

scenarios.name: DAVIS/THOMAS MR
speech: I am escorting a deportee on today's flight.
All required documentation is available.

scenarios.name: BROWN/MICHAEL MR
speech: I am travelling under the supervision of immigration authorities.
I am not accompanied by an escort.

scenarios.name: CLARK/JAMES MR
speech: I purchased an extra seat for my cello.
Will it be seated next to me during the flight?

scenarios.name: WHITE/PETER MR
speech: Immigration refused my entry upon arrival.
I have been instructed to return on the next available flight.

scenarios.name: THOMPSON/MARY MRS
speech: This is my first time travelling internationally.
Could someone meet and assist me through the airport?

scenarios.name: TAYLOR/LISA MS
speech: I recently had surgery.
My doctor provided documentation stating I am fit to fly.

scenarios.name: JONES/OLIVIA MS
speech: My cat will travel with me in the cabin.
She will remain in her carrier under the seat.

scenarios.name: MILLER/ROBERT MR
speech: I require additional assistance while travelling.
Could you arrange support throughout the airport?

scenarios.name: HARRIS/SUSAN MS
speech: I am travelling with a disability.
Please note my requirements in the reservation.

scenarios.name: WALKER/DAVID MR
speech: I am joining my ship in Singapore tomorrow.
My employer arranged this ticket for me.

scenarios.name: KING/ADAM MR
speech: I have a long layover in Amsterdam.
I will remain in transit and do not require a visa.

scenarios.name: ANDERSON/LUCAS MSTR
speech: I'm travelling to Madrid by myself today.
My parents will meet me at the destination airport.

scenarios.name: GREEN/HELEN MRS
speech: I cannot walk at all.
I require assistance from check-in to my seat on board.

scenarios.name: MOORE/STEPHEN MR
speech: I can walk short distances.
However, I need assistance between the terminal and the aircraft.

scenarios.name: JACKSON/ELLA MS
speech: I am able to walk, but I cannot use stairs.
Will a lift be available for boarding?

scenarios.name: SCOTT/MARK MR
speech: I use an onboard wheelchair during the flight.
Has one been arranged for today's service?

scenarios.name: YOUNG/PATRICIA MRS
speech: My wheelchair is manually operated.
Are there any special handling procedures?

scenarios.name: HALL/GEORGE MR
speech: My wheelchair uses a dry-cell battery.
Are there any restrictions for transporting it?

scenarios.name: ALLEN/KAREN MS
speech: My wheelchair uses a wet-cell battery.
What procedures apply before loading it into the hold?

scenarios.name: SMITH/JOHN MR
speech: I am fit and able to assist in an emergency if required.
Please let me know if you need volunteers.

scenarios.name: OPS/DISPATCH
speech: The aircraft assigned to this flight has changed.
Please update the departure information screens.

scenarios.name: CREW/SENIOR FA
speech: Cabin crew, please take your assigned positions.
You will be working in the aft cabin today.

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/MIKE
speech: A technical issue was identified during inspection.
Please record it in the Aircraft Maintenance Log.

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/SARAH
speech: The aircraft cannot continue operations.
It has been declared Aircraft on Ground.

scenarios.name: CAPT/JONES
speech: Ground power is unavailable at this stand.
Please start the Auxiliary Power Unit.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/ANNA
speech: Air Traffic Control has issued a revised departure slot.
Expect a delay of 20 minutes.

scenarios.name: CREW/LISA
speech: Please report to briefing room B.
You are rostered as Cabin Attendant on today's flight.

scenarios.name: OPS/CREW
speech: All cabin crew members should report for briefing at 08:30.
Uniform standards will be checked.

scenarios.name: TRAINER/EMMA
speech: Before operating the flight, please review the Cabin Instruction Manual.
There have been several recent updates.

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/TOM
speech: A damaged seat was reported in row 12.
Please note it in the Cabin Maintenance Log.

scenarios.name: CAPT/BROWN
speech: The Captain will provide an operational briefing before departure.
Please remain seated until it is complete.

scenarios.name: WILSON/FAMILY
speech: We are travelling with a young child.
May we use our approved child restraint device on board?

scenarios.name: NURSE/AMY
speech: A passenger has collapsed in the departure lounge.
Is there anyone trained in CPR nearby?

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/PAUL
speech: The Emergency Locator Transmitter requires inspection.
Maintenance has been notified.

scenarios.name: CREW/ANNE
speech: A passenger suffered a minor cut during boarding.
Please bring the First Aid Kit.

scenarios.name: CREW/DAVID
speech: Smoke was reported in the galley oven.
Use the fire proof gloves before handling the equipment.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/JANE
speech: Flight KL747 is now ready for boarding.
Please proceed to Gate D12.

scenarios.name: CREW/MIKE
speech: A fire extinguisher was discharged during training.
Please replace the Halon bottle immediately.

scenarios.name: STUDENT/EMMA
speech: Which organization publishes airline and airport codes?
I think it might be IATA.

scenarios.name: STUDENT/TOM
speech: Which organization is responsible for international aviation standards?
I believe it is ICAO.

scenarios.name: CREW/LISA
speech: Seat 14A cannot be reclined.
Please mark it as inoperative.

scenarios.name: CREW/SARAH
speech: The forward lavatory is temporarily unavailable.
Please direct passengers to the rear facilities.

scenarios.name: INSPECTOR/JOHN
speech: All life saving appliances were checked before departure.
No defects were found.

scenarios.name: ENGINEER/ROB
speech: The weather radar is inoperative.
Please consult the Minimum Equipment List before departure.

scenarios.name: DOCTOR/LISA
speech: A passenger requires medication during the flight.
Please retrieve the Medical Kit.

scenarios.name: OPS/CONTROL
speech: Operations Control Center has approved the revised flight plan.
Proceed as briefed.

scenarios.name: CREW/EMMA
speech: An oxygen bottle was used during the previous sector.
Please ensure a replacement is available.

scenarios.name: CREW/ANNA
speech: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome on board.
This is a public announcement from your cabin crew.

scenarios.name: CREW/MARK
speech: Smoke procedures have been initiated.
Don the Protective Breathing Equipment immediately.

scenarios.name: OPS/ANNE
speech: The Passenger Information List has been printed.
Please verify the number of passengers on board.

scenarios.name: RAMP/JOE
speech: The doors are closed and the tug is connected.
Request pushback clearance from ATC.

scenarios.name: CAPT/LEE
speech: The captain aborted the take-off due to a warning indication.
The event has been classified as a rejected take-off.

scenarios.name: TRAINER/KIM
speech: Please follow the Standard Operating Procedures at all times.
They are designed to ensure safety and consistency.

scenarios.name: ATC/TOWER
speech: Flight KL764, taxi to runway 18R via taxiway Bravo.
Contact tower when ready.

scenarios.name: CAPT/SMITH
speech: Cabin crew, please take your seats immediately.
Moderate turbulence is expected ahead.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/SUE
speech: Severe weather has been reported near our destination.
Expect possible delays upon arrival.

scenarios.name: OPS/TEAM
speech: The replacement crew is required at Gate F4 as soon as possible.
Please proceed immediately.

scenarios.name: OPS/CONTROL
speech: The Actual Time of Arrival has been recorded as 14:22 local time.
Please update the system accordingly.

scenarios.name: OPS/CONTROL
speech: The aircraft departed the stand at 09:17.
Please enter the Actual Time of Departure.

scenarios.name: PLANNER/MIKE
speech: Based on today's routing, the Estimated Block Time is 2 hours and 15 minutes.
Fuel calculations have been completed.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/EMMA
speech: Our Estimated Time of Arrival is currently 16:45.
Passengers should be informed of the revised schedule.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/PAUL
speech: The Estimated Time of Departure has changed due to congestion.
The new departure time is 11:30.

scenarios.name: OPS/JANE
speech: The Scheduled Time of Arrival is 18:05.
Ground handling staff have been notified.

scenarios.name: OPS/MARK
speech: The Scheduled Time of Departure remains unchanged at 07:00.
Boarding will commence in 20 minutes.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/SARAH
speech: Unfortunately, the inbound aircraft has been delayed.
This is a late incoming aircraft situation.

scenarios.name: DISPATCH/TOM
speech: Your flight has been delayed due to a late incoming aircraft.
We apologize for the inconvenience.

scenarios.name: OPS/CONTROL
speech: Due to adverse weather conditions, today's service has been cancelled.
Please contact customer services for rebooking options.

scenarios.name: GATE/ANNA
speech: A passenger checked in at the last minute.
Please issue a Last Minute Change notification.

scenarios.name: CAPT/JOHN
speech: Captain, the dangerous goods manifest has been updated.
Please review the NOTOC before departure.
